name: Plate in the Form of a Chrysanthemum
dimensions: Diameter: 11.1 cm (4 3/8 in.); Overall: 2 cm (13/16 in.)
summary: This light gray-green jade plate is carved on both sides into the shape of an open chrysanthemum. There are three tiers of concave petals and a central rondel of cross-hatched lines to indicate the pistils.
